name: Work Permit (Foreign Nationals and Commonwealth Citizens (Employment) Act)

requirements.blocker_text: Employer-sponsored; applicant cannot self-apply. Employer must submit a cover letter to the Permanent Secretary addressing recruitment efforts to hire a Jamaican first -- a labour market test built directly into the application questions.

evidence_required.document: Employer's cover letter addressing local recruitment efforts
Work visa (non-Commonwealth citizens must obtain before entering Jamaica)

outcome.duration_length: typically up to 12 months at a time; not transferable between employers (a new application plus termination evidence is required to switch); renewal due 1+ month before expiry

sources.title: Ministry of Labour and Social Security (MLSS), Jamaica -- Work Permit Department: employer-sponsored only, cover letter addressing local-recruitment efforts (labour market test), processing fee JMD 14,400 + duration-scaled permit fee (up to 3mo JMD 27,000; 3-6mo 54,000; 6-9mo 81,000; 9-12mo 108,000), typically issued up to 12 months, not transferable between employers, ~4-6 week processing

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Jamaica). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 MLSS sourced. This is the route for NON-CARICOM foreign nationals; CARICOM nationals in one of the recognized skilled categories instead use jm_caricom_skills.json, which requires no employer sponsorship or labour market test at all -- the two should not be conflated. pr_after_months (36) and citizenship_after_months (60) are cross-referenced from jm_permanent_residence.json and jm_citizenship_naturalisation.json, not independently sourced here.
